Equivalent functions are distributed: provider routing via ModelClientFactory; cost tracking via usage_cost.py:101; circuit breaking via CircuitBreakerRail (circuit_breaker_rail.py:1); content safety via GuardrailRail (guardrail_rail.py:1); observability via ObservabilityHandler (observability/event.py:1).
